new.analysis:
## Reading the week

The plan asked for three walk-run sessions on Mon, Wed and Sat and none of them happened, which is the main thing to understand. You logged no pain, good sleep and low stress, so I am guessing life got in the way rather than your body. If something else was going on, tell me in the next check-in and I will shape the plan around it.

## Why this plan

I am rebuilding at the exact shape of the week of Sep 14 – 20, which you handled with low effort scores and no soreness. That week you ran 2 min, walked 1 min, eight or nine times through, and finished each session feeling 6 or 7 out of 10. Repeating it gives you a confident week back rather than a hard week back.

## How to run it

Keep every running minute conversational, meaning you could speak a short sentence without gasping. The walk minutes are real walks, not a slow jog, because they are what lets the run minutes stay honest. If a session feels easier than a 6 out of 10, that is good news, not a signal to push the pace.

## Looking ahead

If this week lands clean, next week we step the run intervals to 3 min with 1 min walk, which starts closing the gap to a continuous 5K. You have time, but we need three unbroken weeks between now and race day to make the goal realistic. Protect Mon, Wed and Sat like appointments.
